article_bills_statements.summary: Money arrives as documents, and each one means something different. After reading this you can tell a bill from a receipt from a statement, read a statement line by line, check a utility bill against your own usage, dispute a charge you do not recognise, and keep records a tax office will accept.
article_bills_statements.title: Reading Bills, Receipts, and Bank Statements

article_how_ai_works.summary: A language model does not look up answers. It learns patterns from a large amount of text, and at run time it predicts the next token, one token at a time. After reading this you can explain how a model is trained, what the context window holds, why a fluent answer can be wrong, and what to check before you trust an output at work.
article_how_ai_works.title: How AI Actually Works: Training, Prediction and Its Limits
